name: Ankr FlowStakingPool stakeBondsWithCode skips the bond-staking pause and mints ankrFLOW at a 1:1 bearing ratio
summary: Ankr's FlowStakingPool paused bond staking at launch, but its referral entry stakeBondsWithCode lacked the bondStakingUnpaused modifier. _stakeBonds sizes shares with the aFLOWb bearing token's ratio, which the feed returns as 1.0, mints that many ankrFLOW certificates to the bearing contract, and BearingToken.unlockShares hands them out 1:1, so each staked FLOW yielded one ankrFLOW although the certificate ratio was 0.8334 (1 ankrFLOW = 1.2 FLOW). In one transaction the attacker flash-swapped ankrFLOW from the ankrFLOW/WFLOW pool and looped 54 rounds of stakeBondsWithCode and unlockShares, two unstakeCerts redemptions and 50 sales of the new ankrFLOW back into the pool, minting 51.99m ankrFLOW (8.66m of it unbacked), then supplied 13.31m ankrFLOW to MORE Markets in E-mode and borrowed its 15.49m WFLOW reserve.
notes: Sources are verified on the Flow EVM Blockscout (evm.flow.com).

Target and reset: FlowStakingPool proxy 0xfe8189a3, upgraded on 2026-07-22 (0xaf3017a8, block 72897802) to implementation 0x213a1525, whose ReferralLiquidTokenStakingPool.stakeBondsWithCode has no bondStakingUnpaused check; the earlier implementation 0xd812ab5e (2024-09-06) had the same gap, and the next upgrade, to 0x89632e27 on 2026-09-07 (0xe4410abf, block 77761230), adds the modifier with the comment 'the fix: was missing upstream'. Bond staking was paused through EarnConfig at launch in September 2024 and never unpaused (pause state, rule 8). The aFLOWb bearing token's feed ratio of 1e18 against the certificate's 0.8334e18 at the block before the anchor is a feed value, not a reset.

Earlier exploits: Staked events with isRebasing = true (topic 2) on the pool from block 156000 to 78000000 occur only in the anchor (54) and in three transactions of 0x41a1d3ec (blocks 76990537-76990614, contracts created with 300, 500 and 800 FLOW), which ran the same loop for about 2,000 WFLOW each; the bearing token's supply was zero before the anchor.

Loss: the 15,488,124.145 WFLOW that MORE Markets' WFLOW reserve (aToken 0x02bf4bd075c1b7c8d85f54777eaaa3638135c059) lent in the anchor, at DefiLlama's WFLOW price of $0.027497; the 13.31m ankrFLOW collateral left behind is not subtracted (rule 11). Flow Foundation puts the drain at about $410k and the attacker's realised value at about $246k. The ankrFLOW/WFLOW pool 0xbb577ac5 traded 46.27m WFLOW for 38.63m ankrFLOW near the 1.2 FLOW redemption rate and is not counted; the 8.66m unbacked ankrFLOW dilute all holders. The anchor's two unstakeCerts calls redeemed 43,601.95 ankrFLOW for 52,315.82 FLOW (about $1.44k) from the staking pool, which with its forwarding address still gained FLOW net in the transaction, so it is not counted. The copycats' gains came from that pool.
